With MWCoop's MSCLoader, you can keep separate mods for co-op: Mods page, \"Separate mods folder\". Off by default. \"Copy my mods\" copies, without moving anything. The official MSCLoader does not change.
The host can have the game saved every 5 to 30 minutes: Settings > Co-op, or in the lobby. Off by default. At each save, a freeze of a few seconds for everyone, longer on a big game.
Either way, your mods are the ones in the game's Mods folder, unless you choose the separate folder below.
A separate mods folder for co-op
With MWCOOP only: \"Separate mods folder\" (Mods page, off by default) keeps mods different from solo, in your MWCoop folder in AppData. The row shows the folder in use.
\"Copy my mods\" copies the solo ones: the originals do not move, and what is already in the separate folder is kept.
Off: MWCoop goes back to the solo folder. Nothing is deleted. With OFFICIAL, nothing changes.
Autosave: the host can have the game saved every 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes (off by default). At each save, a freeze of a few seconds for everyone, longer on a big game.
